'''Blue Six''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] and [[Blue Five (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Five's]] [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]]. During the [[ambush on Ral's Run]], Blue Six's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] was damaged and the pilot tried to escape back into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Six appears in the opening story for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
